metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.description:
Detects suspicious child processes of Java 
this could indicate code execution.
properties.query:
let ProcessNames = dynamic(["regsvcs.exe","microsoft.workflow.compiler.exe","msbuild.exe","regsvr32.exe","devtoolslauncher.exe","vsjitdebugger.exe","mavinject.exe","presentationhost.exe","ftp.exe","appvlp.exe","certutil.exe","ieexec.exe","bash.exe","sqltoolsps.exe","wsl.exe","jjs.exe","bitsadmin.exe","installutil.exe","syncappvpublishingserver.exe","tracker.exe","regasm.exe","runscripthelper.exe","sqlps.exe","atbroker.exe","schtasks.exe","hh.exe","mshta.exe","verclsid.exe","msxsl.exe","odbcconf.exe","bginfo.exe","msdt.exe"]);
let parent_processes = dynamic(["java.exe"]);
_Im_ProcessCreate(targetprocess_has_any=ProcessNames,parentprocess_has_any=parent_processes)
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
    AccountDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUserDomain", "")),
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DvcHostname", "")),
    ProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessId", "")),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("CommandLine", ""))
| where isnotempty(ProcessName)
